integrity: The theorem is proved analytically, and its strict-cell equality witnesses and independently written exact-rational finite checks accompany the package. Historical uniqueness is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to real Euclidean simplex projection in open-path unweighted first-difference total variation; does not cover cycles, weighted paths, general graphs, or other projection metrics. The result has no independent mathematical audit.
title: Sharp path-variation amplification of Euclidean probability-simplex projection
